meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 3)
topics: my name is / I am … years old

paper:
Hello! I am Sara. I am eight years old. I have got a red bag and two blue pens. Goodbye!

Exercise 1 (4 pts)

  1. What is her name?
  2. How old is she?
  3. What colour is her bag?
  4. How many pens has she got?

Exercise 2 (3 pts)

Match: 1) Good morning! 2) Goodbye! 3) How are you? → a) I’m fine, thank you. b) Good morning! c) Bye!

Exercise 3 (3 pts)

Write the numbers: three = …… , seven = …… , ten = ……
